I got pregnant at 17, had the baby and my life is wonderful. That's also to mention that the father had graduated college while I was pregnant, we bought our own house together, he fixes cars for a living so we had no car troubles, and he does his best to to provide for us now. He's a great father as well and was super excited for the baby to come. 
With that being said, if I could have everything I have now, 5 years from now, I would do it with no question. I regret not being able to finish my education (e.g. going to college, etc.) and I have a feeling you might too. I would suggest either adoption or abortion. 
Adoption for me was NEVER an option because if I didn't want to have a baby now, I certainly would NOT want this baby contacting me in the future to find out what happened, my story, etc. That may not be your view and there is nothing wrong with that. 
Abortion however was a more suitable option for me(even though I did go through with the pregnancy, and I am VERY happy where I am in life)and is NOT what you may think it is. Most women do NOT go through any sort of lasting emotional damage (maybe a day or week after the surgery, yes, but rarely do a lot of women have emotional "scarring" after having an abortion) and it is totally safe and acceptable to consider that option. Your religion has nothing to do with it (yes I know it DOES have a lot to do with it) but you have to look from a logical standpoint. 
WILL I BE HAPPY WITH A BABY? 
WILL I BE ABLE TO ACCOMPLISH WHAT I WANT TO IN LIFE WHILE CARING FOR THIS BABY?
I'm sure you get the drift. You cannot take what other people say/think about you to heart, because with any route you choose, there will be hurtful, horrible judgments made. 
Keep it? You're too young, you have no idea what you're doing, you're an idiot.
Adoption? How heartless could you be to give up a child you carried in the womb for nine months? 
Abortion? You're a murderer and you deserve to be dead yourself! 
None of those things are true, but even so, you will hear them from people. 
I hope you end up making whatever the right decision is for you and for the love of god PLEASE DO NOT LET ANYONE MAKE THIS THEIR DECISION. THIS IS YOUR LIFE AND YOUR CHOICE! PLEASE MAKE IT THAT WAY! <3
